messages:
emma: Heads-up: customer demo hit a vague 'server error' from the Go sample app on a 502 and asked whether to retry. We have no clear guidance printed.

ton y: yikes. we should return structured errors with a short human message + machine fields (code, retryable, retry_after). Go currently returns plain strings in some paths.

rob: proposal: add typed errors across SDKs: AuthError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, TransientServerError, InternalError. each exposes: code (snake_case), message, retryable (bool), retry_after_seconds (opt), server_code (opt).

sara: sample apps should show 'bad' vs 'recommended' handlers. recommended: on 401 attempt one transparent token refresh then fail with AuthError if still 401; on 502/503 do exponential backoff (300ms * 2^n, max 3 attempts); for 429 expose quota headers and no auto-retry unless Retry-After <=5s or user opts in.

emma: also include migration plan: for one release keep backwards-compatible string error but log a deprecation once per process and point to new typed API in changelog.

ton y: small ops request: include optional server_code string so SRE can map to infra incidents. also telemetry-friendly code names like 'rate_limit_exceeded', 'auth_invalid_token'.

rob: I'll own Go changes + tests. sara you want sample app wording?

sara: yes, I'll update the sample app and docs snippet. i'll add a tiny code example and a table mapping HTTP -> exception name -> recommended action.

dx-bot: created ticket DE-917: "SDK error contract + sample app onboarding snippets" and assigned to rob.

emma: thanks — aim for PRs by EOD Thursday. adding a short list of good vs bad message examples to the ticket should cut down support noise.
